title: The Clipboard Moon
skyStory: The moon has grown gibbous, seventy-nine percent and round-shouldered, and stepped into Virgo, the sign of tidy margins and alphabetised spices. It has arrived with a clipboard. Every star is being inspected. Leo has been asked to remove the cape. Mars is sulking. Saturn has never been happier and is helping with the checkboxes.

reading: Virgo is not your natural habitat, Fire Tiger, but it has something to teach you today: finishing. Pick one task that is ninety percent done and drag it across the line before 4 pm.

It will feel slow and fiddly. The last ten percent always does. That is where the [[Knight of Pentacles]] lives, plodding along on a horse who refuses to gallop. The horse is right. When the thing is truly done, celebrate with something ridiculous: a victory lap around the cabin, a cheer to the trees. Virgo will pretend not to be amused but is secretly writing gold star on its clipboard.
joel.mission: Finish one task that is ninety percent done, then do a short victory lap around your home.
joel.omen: A perfectly straight row of something, cans, birds, fence posts. It means order helps you today, so tidy up.

reading: Virgo is an earth sign, your kin. You and the moon will understand each other perfectly today, two practical minds sharing a pot of tea and a list.

Your list is going to be impressive. Resist the urge to add more than five items. Saturn and Virgo together can talk you into overachieving. Instead, choose the item that helps someone else level up and do it first. The rest follow easily. Around sunset, walk to the shore and watch the water sort the pebbles. It has been organising them for centuries and it is still not finished. Neither are you, and that is fine.
nancy.mission: Make a to-do list with exactly five items and cross one off within ten minutes of writing it.
nancy.omen: Neatly stacked stones on a beach or path. It means your patience is paying off quietly.

together.text: Each choose one item to finish today and tell the other what it is by 9 am. Check in at 6 pm with a single word: done, close, or nope. Virgo is keeping score, but it grades on a gentle curve.
